meaning:
λοιδορέω, -ῶ
(λοίδορος) [in LXX chiefly for רִיב ;]
to abuse, revile: with accusative of person(s), Jhn.9:28, Act.23:4; pass., 1Co.4:12, 1Pe.2:23 (cf. ἀντι-λοιδορέω).†
(AS)
glosses: when they heaped abuse on him

renderings.bsb: When they heaped abuse on Him

elsewhere.note: They insulted him and said, “You are his disciple, but we are disciples of Moses.
Those who stood by said, “Do you malign God’s high priest?”
We toil, working with our own hands. When people curse us, we bless. Being persecuted, we endure.
When he was cursed, he didn’t curse back. When he suffered, he didn’t threaten, but committed himself to him who judges righteously.
